basis_for_hypothesis: The project depends on linked Tweede Kamer tables. Failed links or missing fields can remove cases before modelling.
coded_test_used: Overall missingness audit, missingness by subgroup, pipeline file audit, topic file comparison.
evidence_from_this_run: Aanvangstijd_y missingness was 100.0 percent. Eindtijd_y missingness was 100.0 percent. speaker_party missingness was 20.8 percent. Topic feature file lost 14.5 percent of rows between engineered_topics.csv and engineered_topics2.csv.
mitigation_if_present: Do not silently drop missing cases. Document row loss, use cleaned replacement variables where justified, add missingness flags, and compare retained versus removed cases.

basis_for_hypothesis: Literature and interviews suggest that party position, institutional role, agenda access, and political context may matter more than visible debate features.
coded_test_used: Feature set comparison between structural temporal features, speech sentiment features, and party indicators.
evidence_from_this_run: Macro F1 increased from 0.5687 in Model A to 0.5808 in Model C. Difference was 0.0121.
mitigation_if_present: Add political controls where available, such as party indicators, proposer identity, government or opposition status, motion type, policy area, and committee role.

basis_for_hypothesis: Speech duration, sentiment, speaker frequency, and timing are visible indicators. They may reflect deeper mechanisms rather than direct causes of outcomes.
coded_test_used: Subgroup outcome audit by time bin, sentiment label, speaker role, and long speech flag.
evidence_from_this_run: Time bin pattern: Accepted rate ranged from 42.2 percent for evening to 52.5 percent for afternoon. Spread was 10.3 percent. Sentiment pattern: Accepted rate ranged from 46.3 percent for negative to 52.9 percent for positive. Spread was 6.6 percent.
mitigation_if_present: Interpret variables as visible indicators of agenda access, political visibility, public performance, scheduling constraints, and institutional power, not as direct causal predictors.

basis_for_hypothesis: The dataset captures public formal parliamentary debate but not informal negotiation, party discipline, committee bargaining, amendments, lobbying, or stakeholder influence.
coded_test_used: Compare whether visible debate variables alone perform weakly, then check whether party context improves performance.
evidence_from_this_run: Macro F1 increased from 0.5687 in Model A to 0.5808 in Model C. Difference was 0.0121.
audit_status: Risk supported by limited model performance
mitigation_if_present: State clearly that the model audits the visible parliamentary record only. Do not claim that it fully explains decision making.

basis_for_hypothesis: Even when the overall target distribution is balanced, the model may perform differently for accepted and rejected motions or across subgroups.
coded_test_used: Outcome class performance audit, confusion matrix, macro F1, balanced accuracy, subgroup performance audit.
evidence_from_this_run: rejected recall 0.6237, F1 0.5950; accepted recall 0.5399, F1 0.5665
mitigation_if_present: Report class level performance, macro F1, balanced accuracy, and subgroup metrics rather than relying only on overall accuracy.
